description: 5-armed irregular star polygon (~350m x 358m bounding box, 500m diagonal). Arm lengths range from 190m to 220m with 80m-deep concave bays between arms. Represents a survey area with multiple deep concave indentations (e.g., a terrain patch with spiky ridges, a lake with peninsulas, or a multi-lobed forested area).

wind.description: Wind direction 90° (mathematical convention: 0°=East CCW), pointing northward; equivalent to a southerly wind at 3 m/s (wind ratio 0.25)
